extension.description: Display locally installed Codex pets in a PET panel, driven by Cursor, Codex, or Claude hooks.
view.name: PET
config.title: Pet
config.petDirectory: Override the Pet directory. Leave empty to use ~/.pets, then CODEX_HOME/pets. Reload the window after changing it.
config.scale: Pet image size multiplier, or auto to fit the available area. The image still shrinks responsively when the PET view is smaller.
size.autoDescription: Fit the Pet to the available display area.
config.background: Background shown behind the Pet. You can also change it from the webview context menu.
config.customBackgroundImagePath: Local PNG, WebP, or GIF file used when the background is Custom Image. Files must be no larger than 20 MB.
config.customBackgroundOpacity: Opacity of the custom background image, from 0 (transparent) to 1 (opaque).
config.pauseWhenHidden: Pause animation while the Pet webview is hidden.
config.watchPetDirectory: Reload Pets automatically when files change.
config.integrationMode: Choose automatic agent Hooks integration or manual state commands.
integration.hooks: Install hooks for every available agent and reflect activity from the selected listener.
config.hookProvider: Which provider event stream the pet listens to. Changing this does not install or remove hooks.
background.none: Use the VS Code theme background.
background.custom: Use one local PNG, WebP, or GIF image.
